source.text: MUTATION SLOTS. At Warrior 1 you have one mutation slot; slot II unlocks at Warrior 5, slot III at Warrior 13 and slot IV at Warrior 20. During a completed short or long rest, equip one eligible mutation in each slot. Equipped mutations are dormant until activated unless their text explicitly says otherwise. You cannot equip the same named mutation twice.

SERUM RESERVE. After a long rest prepare two serum doses, choosing one of the six serum profiles for each dose. At Warrior 11 the reserve becomes three prepared doses; at Warrior 20 it becomes four. Used doses do not naturally refill on a short rest. A long rest refills the reserve. Serum Recycling and explicit class features can preserve or restore doses, but no effect can increase the reserve above its current capacity.

STRAIN. Begin after a long rest at 0 Strain; maximum Strain is 3. A normal serum injection or Mutagen Injection adds 1 Strain, Mutation Surge adds 1, and Serum Cocktail or Mutation Overload adds 2 unless modified. At Strain 2 your Speed is reduced by 5 feet. At Strain 3 you also take -1 AC and -1 on saving throws and cannot voluntarily activate another serum, Cocktail, Overclock or Surge until Strain is reduced. A completed short rest reduces Strain by 1; a long rest resets it to 0. Strain cannot exceed 3.

Mutation Adaptation and Serum Tolerance modify Strain and serum-profile side effects only as their cards state. A negative serum-profile side effect and Strain penalty are separate; preventing one does not automatically prevent the other.

RECHARGE GUARD. A named ability may receive at most one positive-counter reset or shortening per round. Only an ability with a positive recharge counter can be reset. Recharge never restores a spent short-rest or long-rest use unless the feature explicitly says it restores that use.

HEALING AND REGENERATION. Warrior healing cannot exceed maximum HP, restore the dead or remove Wounds unless a card explicitly says otherwise. Regeneration and repeated healing effects operate only during real encounters unless their card explicitly permits downtime healing. No corpse, summoned creature, trivial enemy or friendly target can be used to create infinite healing, serum doses or BT.

HERO MUTATION TREES. Bulwark Mutation Tree, Gore Mutation Tree and Aberrant Mutation Tree are Hero cards that unlock their associated Hero-specific mutation extra Cards. Those mutations still occupy normal mutation slots and obey active-mutation, serum and Strain rules.

Finite recovery completion: Mutation Recovery Reserve=3 L+M HP after a long rest. Bloodthick Node, Rapid Coagulation, Regenerative Mutation, Hemophage Core and their healing enhancements draw from this shared reserve, 1 point per actual HP healed. No short-rest refill; no gauge, critical hit, free activation or form change replenishes it. Other explicitly limited-use/dose healing retains its own printed limit. This new test reserve prevents indefinite regenerative healing from free mutation activations.

card.name: Mutation Adaptation
card.effect: Mutation Adaptation. Ignore the Strain-2 Speed penalty. The first time in each encounter that activating a mutation or serum would add Strain, reduce that Strain gain by 1, minimum 0. This reduction cannot reduce Serum Cocktail or Mutation Overload below 1 Strain and cannot reduce existing Strain.

source.originalText: Mutation Adaptation: Your body has been conditioned to accept mutations with reduced side effects.

card.name: Serum Tolerance
card.effect: Serum Tolerance. Negative side effects printed on serum profiles do not affect you. Strain generation and Strain penalties still apply normally. This does not suppress drawbacks printed on mutation cards, Hero transformations or Mutation Overload.

source.originalText: Serum Tolerance: You can consume serums without the normal toxicity effects that would affect others.

card.name: Serum Injection
card.frequency: At will while legal doses remain
card.effect: Serum Injection. Choose one equipped mutation and one prepared serum dose. Consume the dose, activate that mutation for 3 rounds and apply the serum profile for 3 rounds. Observe active-mutation limits, Strain legality and nonstacking same-profile bonuses.

source.originalText: Serum Injection: Activate a prepared mutation serum as a bonus action, triggering its effects for 3 rounds.

card.name: Mutation Efficiency
card.effect: Mutation Efficiency. You may maintain up to two equipped mutations active simultaneously instead of one. Activating a third mutation while two are already active requires choosing one active mutation to become dormant unless another explicit feature temporarily raises this limit. Mutation slots, serum costs, Strain and mutation durations remain unchanged.

source.originalText: Mutation Efficiency: May have 2 active mutations at once (Lv 3)

card.name: Overpressure Response
card.duration: 3 rounds or its shorter printed duration
card.effect: Overpressure Response. When you take a critical hit, choose one equipped dormant non-Apex mutation and activate it without consuming a serum dose or gaining Strain. This activation must respect your normal simultaneous-active-mutation limit; if necessary, make another active mutation dormant. It grants no serum-profile benefit and cannot activate a mutation whose prerequisite you do not meet.

source.originalText: Overpressure Response: Once per round, when struck by a critical hit, gain 1 free mutation activation

card.name: Mutation Overload
card.duration: 2 rounds; backlash until end of following turn
card.effect: Mutation Overload. For 2 rounds, enhance each currently active mutation once: an AC, DR, attack, save or flat-damage bonus increases by 1; a movement or reach bonus increases by 5 feet; or one mutation damage/healing roll gains +1d4. Immunities, target counts, resource generation and action grants cannot be increased. When Overload ends, you suffer -1 on attack rolls and saving throws and -5 feet Speed until the end of your next regular turn. This activation is illegal if +2 Strain would exceed the Strain cap.

source.originalText: Mutation Overload: Push your mutations beyond safe limits, gaining significantly enhanced effects for 2 rounds followed by exhaustion.

card.name: Serum Cocktail
card.cost: Consume 2 different prepared serum doses; +2 Strain
card.effect: Serum Cocktail. Choose two different prepared serum profiles, consume both doses and apply both profiles to yourself for 3 rounds while activating one eligible equipped mutation. Same-stat bonuses use only the stronger value. Both profile side effects apply unless Serum Tolerance suppresses them. This activates only one mutation and therefore differs from Serum Overclock. It is illegal if the resulting Strain would exceed 3.

source.originalText: Serum Cocktail: Combine two different serums for a hybrid effect, though with increased strain on your body.

card.name: Serum Sharing
card.rangeAndTarget: One willing living ally you touch
card.frequency: At most once per ally per short rest
card.effect: Serum Sharing. Inject one willing ally with a diluted prepared serum. The ally receives half of each positive numeric benefit of that serum profile, rounded down with minimum 1, for 3 rounds; nonnumeric immunities become advantage on the relevant save instead. The serum activates no mutation in the ally. The ally gains 1 Strain for this pilot and suffers the profile's printed side effect. Your Serum Tolerance does not protect the ally.

source.originalText: Serum Sharing: You can safely inject allies with diluted versions of your serums, granting them 50% of the benefits.

card.name: Bulwark Mutation Tree
card.effect: Bulwark Mutation Tree. Unlock the Wardborn-specific mutations Spinal Plating, Adrenal Overwatch and Living Cover as eligible mutation choices. They occupy normal mutation slots, require serum activation unless their card says otherwise, and obey all active-mutation, tier and Strain rules. Selecting this card does not automatically equip or activate any of them.

source.originalText: Bulwark Mutation Tree: Unlocks mutations like:

card.name: Serum Recycling
card.rangeAndTarget: One serum dose you are consuming
card.effect: Serum Recycling. Whenever you would consume a prepared serum dose, roll a d20. On 17-20, the dose is not consumed after its effects resolve. Strain and all other costs still apply. A preserved dose remains in its original prepared profile and cannot increase your serum reserve above its normal capacity.

source.originalText: Serum Recycling: 20% chance to not consume a serum when activating a mutation.

card.name: Gore Mutation Tree
card.effect: Gore Mutation Tree. Unlock the Ironskin-specific mutations Gore Maw, Reinforced Joints and Shard Skin as eligible mutation choices. They occupy normal mutation slots and obey serum activation, concurrency, tier and Strain rules. Selecting this card equips or activates none of them automatically.

source.originalText: Gore Mutation Tree: Unlocks mutations like:

card.name: Aberrant Mutation Tree
card.effect: Aberrant Mutation Tree. Unlock the Dreadspawn-specific mutations Whip-Tendon Limbs, Soul Spike Carapace and Hemophage Core as eligible mutation choices. They occupy normal mutation slots and obey serum activation, concurrency, tier and Strain rules. Selecting this card does not equip or activate any of them.

card.name: Apex Aberration (1/day)
card.effect: Apex Aberration. For 2 rounds increase Strength by 4, maximum 24 from this feature. You are immune to the effects and damage of hostile rank-3-or-lower spells, but not higher-rank spells, non-spell magical abilities or friendly spells you choose to accept. Whenever your weapon or natural attack hits, the target makes a Wisdom save; on failure it is Frightened until the end of its next turn. This activation is illegal if +2 Strain would exceed the cap.

source.originalText: Apex Aberration (1/day): You transform for 2 rounds:

card.name: Serum Overclock
card.effect: Inject two different prepared serum profiles simultaneously and activate up to two eligible equipped mutations, respecting your active-mutation limit. Resolve both profile effects; same-stat bonuses use the stronger. Overclock is illegal if the resulting Strain would exceed 3.
card.prerequisite: Warrior 9, Strain 1 or lower, two prepared serum doses

source.originalText: | 9 | Serum Overclock: Inject 2 serums at once |

card.name: Awakened
card.effect: Once per encounter, when a serum activation would add Strain, reduce that Strain gain by 1, minimum 0. This represents reduced activation cost; it cannot reduce Serum Cocktail or Mutation Overload below 1 Strain.

source.originalText: | Awakened | Deal 25% of max HP as damage | Mutations cost 10% less to activate |

card.name: Overdrive
card.effect: Gain +2 to Strength or Dexterity, chosen on preparation, and +10 feet Speed. Side effect: -1 AC for the duration. Serum Tolerance suppresses the side effect but not Strain.

card.name: Sanguine Surge
card.frequency: Per prepared dose; same creature cannot receive its healing more than once per short rest
card.effect: On injection regain 2d6 HP and gain +10 feet Speed for 3 rounds. Side effect: when the profile ends gain 1 additional Strain, maximum 3. Serum Tolerance suppresses that ending side effect. This healing removes no Wounds and cannot operate on a dead creature.

source.originalText: | Sanguine Surge | Heal 2d6 | +10 ft speed | 3 rounds | Increased Hunger |

source.text: Afterward, suffer 1 Strain and disadvantage on Dexterity checks for 1 hour.
A safe evening of chosen recreation removes 1 Strain, never a Wound.
